book.name: Amatiu
book.title: Ib̠eb̠i Asu̠gbagba Ma̠ Agu̠o̠ Amatiu Age̠ Bho̠

content: Omugh ta̠ Azo̠n Owurmamu̠m bho̠
Igiel bho̠ E̠ro̠d we̠mu̠ irileghom odi agba ebhugh
bho̠, amu̠gho̠n o̠du̠ ta̠ A̠zizo̠s bho̠,
sa̠ i̠na a̠fugh a̠nigha̠ ma̠ rob̠a̠ra̠motu d̠o̠yo̠ ma̠a̠, “Onon ta̠ aro̠ ma̠ Azo̠n Owurmamu̠m bho̠; i̠na na̠ a̠b̠etina̠ d̠a̠ omugh! Obha̠ ezin bho̠ ra̠limon i̠nye̠n na̠ i̠kpasan i̠na bho̠.”
Ezin bho̠ E̠ro̠d a̠b̠ol Azo̠n, sa̠ adu̠o̠m d̠a̠ ikoli ma̠ ebula̠ E̠ro̠di̠as ani̠ ta̠ A̠filip umor d̠o̠yo̠.
Ezin bho̠ Azo̠n a̠fugh a̠nigha̠ i̠na ma̠a̠: “Na̠ osora̠n d̠o̠ nyam ma̠ obhin E̠ro̠di̠as ani̠.”
Sa̠ E̠ro̠d abho̠ro̠gh ogigh Azo̠n, ya̠a̠ i̠na a̠ghil a̠nwunom bho̠, ezin bho̠ awa eloghom ma̠ Azo̠n owil.
D̠a̠ a̠d̠a̠ma̠ e̠yal i̠mara ta̠ E̠ro̠d, sa̠ o̠nyani̠ ta̠ E̠ro̠di̠as aghe̠r d̠a̠ a̠misigh ogbo o̠d̠e̠ bho̠ ma̠ ola̠ a̠d̠igh ologi ma̠ E̠ro̠d.
Ebula̠ o̠ku̠a, sa̠ E̠ro̠d a̠sibhigha̠ a̠gua̠n onigha̠ o̠nyani̠ bho̠ kere kere abar ola̠ ta̠ a̠puru i̠na.

Sa̠ o̠nyani̠ bho̠ agi̠ ka̠ a̠pura̠n onweni d̠o̠yo̠ ma̠ abar wa̠ i̠na ta̠ a̠puru bho̠, sa̠ oweni d̠o̠yo̠ a̠ruom i̠na ma̠ o̠gi̠ ka̠ o̠gba onigha̠ E̠ro̠d ma̠a̠, “Nigha̠ ami̠ ma̠ i̠se̠n i̠se̠n e̠mu̠ ta̠ Azo̠n Owurmamu̠m bho̠ d̠a̠ e̠kpa imobh.”
Sa̠ o̠li̠le̠ma bho̠ a̠b̠ogina̠, ya̠a̠ ebula̠ i̠zo̠ bho̠ na̠ ogbo o̠d̠e̠ bho̠, sa̠ i̠na a̠ruom awa ma̠ onigha̠ o̠nyani̠ bho̠ ma̠ abar wa̠ i̠na a̠puru bho̠.
Sa̠ i̠na ato̠ ma̠ a̠nwunom ma̠ o̠gi̠ ka̠ osobh e̠mu̠ ta̠ Azo̠n d̠a̠ ologi ikoli bho̠.
Sa̠ awa irol e̠mu̠ bho̠ d̠a̠ e̠kpa imobh ra̠ inigha̠ ma̠ o̠gbara o̠nyani̠ bho̠, sa̠ o̠nyani̠ bho̠ a̠bhin ka̠ a̠nigha̠ ma̠ onweni d̠o̠yo̠.
Sa̠ ogbo atu̠ghan ta̠ Azo̠n i̠gi̠ ka̠ irol ekuna̠ bho̠ i̠d̠u̠a ka̠ id̠i, sa̠ i̠gi̠ ka̠ i̠gba inigha̠ ma̠ A̠zizo̠s.
A̠zizo̠s A̠nigha̠ ma̠ Ed̠ia̠n ma̠D̠iobh na̠ I̠wal O̠ni̠r na̠ Ogho E̠wala (5,000) O̠ni̠

Igiel bho̠ A̠zizo̠s amu̠gho̠n abar wa̠ a̠mutuma̠ ma̠ Azo̠n bho̠, sa̠ i̠na ku̠ku̠m a̠d̠igh d̠a̠ oghugh sa̠ ad̠u̠a agi̠ ma̠ esi ola̠ aro̠ kukunum. Sa̠ agu̠o̠ o̠lo̠gh a̠nwunom bho̠ i̠mu̠gho̠n bho̠, sa̠ awa i̠d̠u̠a d̠a̠ re̠ma d̠awa i̠wo̠l ya̠ a̠wel i̠tu̠o̠no̠m i̠na.
Igiel bho̠ i̠na na̠ a̠bhun d̠a̠ egbolom bho̠, sa̠ i̠na abi̠gh obom o̠lo̠gh a̠nwunom sa̠ igbirigbir awa id̠ighi i̠na, sa̠ a̠koko ma̠ ogbo asu̠nwe̠r ya̠ od̠i d̠a̠ o̠lo̠gh bho̠.

Igiel bho̠ a̠d̠io na̠ ate̠i̠ a̠dule bho̠, sa̠ ogbo atu̠ghan bho̠ iru ra̠ ifugh inigha̠ i̠na ma̠a̠, “Onon esi ola̠ od̠i kukunum, ya̠a̠ obhel na̠ a̠ten. Ruome ma̠ o̠lo̠gh a̠nwunom bho̠ ma̠ e̠d̠u̠a e̠gi̠ d̠a̠ re̠ma bho̠ ka̠ eghoyogh ed̠ia̠n ya̠ awa ta̠ ed̠e.”
Ya̠a̠ A̠zizo̠s a̠fugh ma̠a̠,

content.text: “Na̠ osora̠n d̠o̠ awa ma̠ o̠d̠u̠a. Inigha̠ awa ma̠ abar od̠e.”

content: Sa̠ i̠wo̠ran i̠na ma̠a̠, “I̠yar unwuna̠ d̠o̠ ma̠ abar esi onon, a̠ten ogho ikpokpogh abre̠di̠ na̠ i̠wal ikpo ina̠.”
Sa̠ i̠na awo̠ran ma̠a̠,

Sa̠ i̠na a̠ruom o̠lo̠gh a̠nwunom bho̠ ma̠ e̠ro̠ ma̠ a̠dila̠de d̠a̠ i̠gho̠gho̠ bho̠. Sa̠ i̠na a̠bhin ogho ikpokpogh abre̠di̠ bho̠ na̠ i̠wal ikpo ina̠ bho̠, sa̠ a̠b̠eka̠ a̠kpon d̠a̠ ote̠nai̠ny a̠tutumeni ma̠ ed̠ia̠n bho̠. Sa̠ i̠na a̠pupugion a̠nigha̠ ma̠ ogbo atu̠ghan bho̠, sa̠ awa i̠ru̠gi̠ iinigha̠ ma̠ o̠lo̠gh a̠nwunom bho̠.
Sa̠ eb̠la̠ awa id̠e, sa̠ ilegha̠n ko̠ni̠ko̠ni̠, sa̠ ikokod̠i ma̠ i̠pe̠re̠pe̠r ya̠ isughia̠n bho̠ imuzoghod̠i d̠iobh na̠ i̠wal (12) a̠rukpuom.
Aro̠ ka̠ d̠iobh na̠ i̠wal o̠ni̠r na̠ ogho e̠wala (5,000) ilobhiri a̠nwunom id̠e. U̠wal ani̠ d̠o̠ ma̠ anwani̠ na̠ i̠gbara anwi̠i̠ny ya̠ id̠e ani̠ bho̠.
A̠zizo̠s A̠rile d̠a̠ Anyu̠ Amu̠m

D̠a̠ onin obhel obha̠, sa̠ A̠zizo̠s a̠nugi ma̠ ogbo atu̠ghan d̠o̠yo̠, ma̠ ed̠igh d̠a̠ oghugh ed̠ia̠ eb̠etina̠ na̠ i̠na i̠b̠e̠i̠y d̠a̠ aku̠b̠o̠ bho̠, ya̠a̠ i̠na ta̠ aro̠ a̠b̠a̠ra̠ tu̠tu̠n ka̠ i̠na na̠ a̠ruom o̠lo̠gh a̠nwunom bho̠ ma̠ oyeleghu o̠mado̠n.
Igiel bho̠ o̠lo̠gh a̠nwunom bho̠ na̠ eyeleghu bho̠, sa̠ i̠na asi̠n d̠a̠ anyu̠ igu ka̠ a̠siseiny tu̠tu̠n a̠d̠io a̠kpegi, sa̠ i̠na ku̠ku̠m aro̠ ma̠ i̠se̠.
D̠a̠ obhel obha̠, oghugh bho̠ na̠ agi̠ ma̠ egbeiny d̠a̠ obodo bho̠, sa̠ opoka̠n amu̠m bho̠ na̠ a̠b̠oroghom awa, ezin bho̠ ogim bho̠ na̠ a̠gim na̠ adama awa.
Igiel bho̠ ate̠i̠ obhel ogir wa̠ ame̠ghe̠le̠
bho̠, sa̠ A̠zizo̠s a̠rile d̠a̠ anyu̠ amu̠m agi̠ ka̠ ate̠i̠ awa.
Ya̠a̠ igiel bho̠ ogbo atu̠ghan bho̠ i̠bi̠gh agu̠o̠ i̠na na̠ a̠rile d̠a̠ anyu̠ amu̠m bho̠, sa̠ rologi d̠awa ikpoyogh, sa̠ ifugh ma̠a̠, “Obha̠ e̠mu̠gh o,” sa̠ ikpo ma̠ izul d̠a̠ ebula̠ a̠rugugu.
Ogbo na̠ onin, sa̠ A̠zizo̠s a̠fugh a̠nigha̠ awa ma̠a̠,

content.text: “I̠kpo̠ ma̠ ologi. O̠ni̠ ko oghil a̠rugugu. Ami̠!”

content: Sa̠ A̠pita̠ a̠fugh ma̠a̠, “Wa̠nwuna̠, ku̠gba ma̠ anwa na̠ agu̠o̠ ga̠i, bha̠ ruome ami̠ ma̠ orile d̠a̠ anyu̠ amu̠m bho̠ oru d̠oyom.”
Sa̠ i̠na awo̠ran ma̠a̠,
Sa̠ A̠pita̠ ad̠u̠a d̠a̠ oghugh bho̠ a̠sor a̠rile d̠a̠ anyu̠ amu̠m bho̠ na̠ agi̠ d̠a̠ A̠zizo̠s.
Sa̠ agu̠o̠ i̠na abi̠gh e̠mi̠ ogim bho̠, sa̠ a̠rugugu isibh i̠na, sa̠ i̠na ake̠ ma̠ od̠in, sa̠ i̠na a̠mulughu a̠fugh ma̠a̠, “Wa̠nwuna̠, tenemeni ami̠.”
Ogbo na̠ onin, sa̠ A̠zizo̠s agi̠o̠m agu̠o̠ d̠o̠yo̠ a̠sibh i̠na sa̠ a̠fugh a̠nigha̠ i̠na ma̠a̠,

content.text: “O̠ni̠ ologi ima̠ra̠ o̠ghu̠a d̠o̠, ologi d̠oyom na̠ a̠kpo ma̠ ere?”

content: Sa̠ i̠wal awa ipel id̠igh d̠a̠ oghugh bho̠, sa̠ ogim bho̠ a̠lia̠.
Sa̠ ogbo ya̠ od̠i d̠a̠ oghugh bho̠ ikpud̠ia̠n inigha̠ i̠na d̠a̠ ozuruna̠ eghoi, sa̠ ifugh ma̠a̠, “Ya̠gia̠ga̠i, anwa O̠nyi̠ ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠.”
Sa̠ awa i̠b̠e̠i̠ ka̠ isul d̠a̠ Age̠ne̠sare̠t.
Sa̠ a̠nwunom e̠ma bho̠ ilelegi i̠na, sa̠ iruom ka̠ obhinogh eb̠la̠ ogbo asu̠nwe̠r d̠a̠ eghighira̠ bho̠ oru d̠o̠yo̠.
Sa̠ awa i̠le̠gh i̠na ma̠a̠ i̠na a̠ma̠ra̠ ma̠ ogbo asu̠nwe̠r bho̠ ma̠ okula̠n bebina̠ esi bho̠ u̠labh akapa d̠o̠yo̠ bho̠, sa̠ eb̠la̠ ogbo ya̠ ikula̠n bho̠ id̠um i̠man.

footnotes.text: E̠ro̠d aro̠ ma̠ we̠mu̠ irileghom odi agba d̠a̠ inya̠ a̠bin d̠a̠ ebhugh Izre̠l.
Obhel ogir wa̠ ame̠ghe̠le̠ Ob̠eton d̠a̠ i̠sar ka̠ o̠te̠i̠ d̠a̠ odin aki̠lo̠ki̠ ma̠ ame̠ghe̠le̠. Idi ogbo na̠ eb̠a̠ra̠ ma̠ asi̠ro̠, idi etita̠n, idi a̠d̠uga̠la̠n.
